L1.text: The strongest fighter in the universe was looking for a worthy opponent.

L2.text: Show yourself! I will defeat anyone!

L3.text: Somehow, he ended up in a kitchen.

L4.text: Oh, hi! Are you here for the dishes?

L5.text: Dishes? I am Kai! I have defeated a thousand warriors!

L6.text: Cool! I have defeated a thousand frying pans.

L7.text: Then teach me your training, little sponge.

L12.text: The cup exploded. Then the bowls. Then the window.

L13.text: This is the hardest training I have ever done.

L15.text: Scrubby jumped into the sink and soaked up every single drop.

L19.text: Kai has washed the dishes every day since. He is still not allowed to touch the cups.
